fieldValues.title: WG Agent-supported editor: cycle 2026-10-24
fieldValues.chose: Closed the cycle 2026-10-23 11:30 to 2026-10-24 11:30 UTC. A quiet cycle: no group PR merged, none open, nothing stopped, no escalation raised. The owner ruled on decision 5d5feb79 at the 11:03 session today (option A: the brief becomes typed data in the essay package), so the group's critical path is now a package release in muDemocracy.org, not an open question. Four new essay issues (srs-web#587 to #590) were filed on 2026-10-23. Pause state: ok. No decision awaited assent, so no group session was held.
fieldValues.rationale: No new escalation. 5d5feb79 was the only open one and the owner has ruled on it. Its step 2 (file the package change in muDemocracy.org for the brief, the context-document marker and the feedback flag) is not filed yet; that is a Builder or owner task, not a Steward one.
fieldValues.figures: Delegated merges (group-state): 0 of 10; 0 open. Ready + wg:agent-editor issues: 1 (semanticops.com#14, the owner's dogfood run). Needs-input: srs-web#567, #571. Blocked: srs-web#591, #592, #514, #426. Ratified decisions across the programme: about 89, so the srs-web#560 build trigger (about 10) is reached.
